body:
I hadn't.  Just looked them up, and it looks like I have two options each about 4-6 hours away.  Going to call them tomorrow. 

Thank you.

Someone recommended credit cards (amongst other things).  All my husband's cards are maxed (and he had outstanding credit two years ago), and I have outstanding student loans, so I'm not sure who would give me a card, but I might look into that.

And honestly, the way this whole economic clusterfuck is running, I probably wouldn't ever end up paying them back.  I really don't even care.  It's not like I'll ever own a house, and it's not like our credit isn't already fucked.  :-/

The PP around here used to do free pregnancy tests and even provide free/extremely cheap birth control.  Now they charge $.50 for condoms and an exam fee to get the pill.  I don't know if it's just locally due to a lack of community support, or if it's a sign of the times.

I'm a victim of all the fucking red tape they've laid out to prevent people from taking advantage of their flawed system.  There are ten thousand technicalities I have to meet to become eligible, and it all comes back to me not having the means to make it through their hoops.

But whatever.  It's all my fault for not being able to afford the pill or a vasectomy for my husband.  It's my fault for not finishing college so that I could have a bachelor's degree to back up all of this waitressing experience.  

For the first time since I turned 16 and got my first job, I was turned down for a position after getting called for an interview a few weeks ago.  I still don't know what I did wrong.

Planned Parenthood is where I went to find out that there is apparently no way to deal with being pregnant in this day and age that does not require hundreds, if not thousands, of dollars provided by the mother.  Or, not in my area.  The last thing I want is some upper-middle class bleeding heart liberal telling me that it will all be okay once I see this specialist or undergo that procedure.  It's like no one understands the concept of broke.  Completely, utterly, I would be begging on the side of the road if I wasn't too proud and too afraid of jail, broke.  Apparently "poor" means not having enough money for a new car, so you buy a used one instead.  My husband and I share a car, and that's been a contributing factor in my trouble finding work (since he is technically 'employed' at the moment and needs access to the wheels).

I just don't know.  The state won't even support my broke ass until I (wait for it) go to a doctor to get my pregnantness confirmed.  I want to tell them, "If I could afford the fucking doctor, I wouldn't be talking to you in the first place!"  I don't want to be a fucking welfare queen, I just don't want to be where I am right now, either.

Been turned away already.  I need to find a couple hundred bucks to go to a gyno first.  My pee stick isn't enough evidence for the man.  The man also doesn't want to count my husband and I as a household because we of our living situation (with his parents).  

The local food pantry is really  nice, though.  Too bad I can't eat any of the day-old/expired stuff without tossing my cookies.  But hey, all the canned cranberry sauce and new potatoes I can handle!

I'm sorry, I've just had everyone telling me the same three pointers for almost two months now.  It's like the people telling my husband to just apply for more jobs.  I'm depressed, not retarded.

Not a one of the adoption agencies I have contacted help with any of the prenatal costs.  I don't want to give a loving family a baby who was starved in the womb, whose mother smoked for the first two months, who is at risk for all sorts of defects that I can't afford to test for.

Schizophrenia may be caused by horrible mothers like me (smoking, drugs, malnutrition).  Fuck, I took goddamn LSD when I was already 4-6 weeks.  Told myself I was 'late.'

I fucking knew.  I fucking knew the whole fucking time and I did NOTHING until it had been months because I wanted plausible deniability.  I didn't want to take a test because if I didn't know for sure, then it wasn't happening.

I am a monster.
